name: angelscript-lsp
description: Language support for AngelScript: hover, go to definition, completion, semantic highlighting, diagnostics, formatting and refactoring, powered by a native C++ Tree-sitter engine.

semanticTokenTypes.description: The '<' and '>' delimiting a template argument list. Separate from 'operator' because the TextMate grammar cannot tell '>>' closing two templates from the right-shift operator; the server can, and this is the type it reports them as.

angelscript.searchDirectories.markdownDescription: Custom directory search paths for resolving included script files (`#include "path.as"`).

angelscript.predefinedFiles.markdownDescription: Predefined stub files declaring the host application's API, loaded by path. Absolute paths are used as-is, so the stub can live outside the workspace (e.g. `C:/Games/svencoop/as.predefined`); relative paths are resolved against each workspace folder. Files inside the workspace whose name ends with `#angelscript.predefinedExtension` are picked up automatically and need no entry here.

angelscript.predefinedExtension.markdownDescription: Filename suffix that marks a file found in the workspace as a predefined stub. This is a suffix, not a path - use `#angelscript.predefinedFiles` to load a specific file.

angelscript.fileExtension.markdownDescription: Filename suffix of AngelScript source files, used when scanning the workspace to build the `#include` graph.

angelscript.arrayLikeTypes.markdownDescription:
Names of template types whose initializer list is a plain repeat of their element type, the way `array<T>`'s is. The engine's default array type is always included.

This is shorthand. The general mechanism is a `/// @listpattern {repeat T}` tag on the class in your `.as.predefined` stub, copied from the type's own `asBEHAVE_LIST_FACTORY` registration — that also expresses patterns this setting cannot, such as `dictionary`'s `{repeat {string, ?}}`. Use this setting when you cannot edit the stub.

Either way it has to be stated rather than detected: `array<T>` and `optional<T>` are declared identically in a stub, and the compiler accepts `array<int> a = {1};` while rejecting `optional<int> o = {1};`.

angelscript.diagnosticSeverity.markdownDescription: Overrides the severity of individual diagnostics, keyed by diagnostic code. Example: `{ "as-warn-unused-variable": "hint" }`.

angelscript.features.hover.markdownDescription: Show type and documentation tooltips on hover.

angelscript.features.definition.markdownDescription: Enable Go to Definition and Go to Type Definition.

angelscript.features.signatureHelp.markdownDescription: Show parameter hints while typing a call.

angelscript.features.predefinedLoader.markdownDescription: Load predefined stub files describing the host application's API.

angelscript.features.documentSymbols.markdownDescription: Populate the Outline view and breadcrumbs.

angelscript.features.documentHighlight.markdownDescription: Highlight other occurrences of the symbol under the cursor.

angelscript.features.inlayHints.markdownDescription: Show inline parameter-name and deduced-type hints.

angelscript.features.implementation.markdownDescription: Go to Implementation: from an interface or a base class to the types that answer to it, and from a method to the ones that implement or override it.

angelscript.features.selectionRange.markdownDescription: Expand selection: grow the selection one syntactic step at a time.

angelscript.features.callHierarchy.markdownDescription: Call hierarchy: who calls this function, and what it calls in turn.

angelscript.features.typeHierarchy.markdownDescription: Type hierarchy: the bases a class or interface declares, and the types that declare it as theirs.

angelscript.features.linkedEditing.markdownDescription: Linked editing: retype a local variable or a parameter and its uses together, live. Offered only for names a lexical scope keeps inside one file - anything at file scope goes through Rename instead, which looks across documents.

angelscript.features.codeLens.markdownDescription: Show actionable code lenses (references, implementations) inline above declarations.

angelscript.features.onTypeFormatting.markdownDescription: Automatically format code on typing specific trigger characters (semicolon, closing brace, newline).

angelscript.features.typeConversionCheck.markdownDescription: Report conversions with no constructor, `opConv`/`opImplConv` or `opCast`/`opImplCast` to back them.

angelscript.engine.allowUnsafeReferences.markdownDescription:
Set this if the host calls `SetEngineProperty(asEP_ALLOW_UNSAFE_REFERENCES, true)`.

With it off — the engine's default — `&` on a parameter means `&inout` and only an object type that supports handles may use it, so `void f(int &x)` is an error. With it on, primitives may be passed by reference and the diagnostic is not reported.

angelscript.engine.privatePropAsProtecte.markdownDescription:
Set this if the host calls `SetEngineProperty(asEP_PRIVATE_PROP_AS_PROTECTED, true)`.

A `private` member then follows the `protected` rule, so a derived class may reach it and the access is no longer reported.

angelscript.engine.disallowGlobalVars.markdownDescription:
Set this if the host calls `SetEngineProperty(asEP_DISALLOW_GLOBAL_VARS, true)`.

Every global variable declaration is then a compile error — the engine answers "Global variables have been disabled by the application" — and is reported as one.

angelscript.engine.profile.markdownDescription: Built-in AngelScript engine profile to automatically load predefined API stubs and rules (e.g. `svencoop`, `urho3d`, `standard`, `auto`).

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint && npm run check-settings
